features: 【COMPACT KEYBOARD】This ultra-thin and lightweight keyboard boasts a sleek profile, measuring only 5 millimeters in thickness and featuring a lightweight design. Smaller than traditional keyboards, it offers exceptional portability, allowing users to carry it effortlessly or slip it into a bag, making it suitable for home, school, office, or travel use. Its dimensions are 24.7 x 15 x 5 centimeters (9.72 x 5.9 x 0.19 inches), with a weight of just 165 grams (5.82 ounces).

【EXTENSIVE COMPATIBILITY】This wireless keyboard and mouse is widely compatible with various devices, including Android, Windows, Mac OS, and iOS systems. They can connect to Bluetooth-enabled devices such as tablets, iPads, iPhones, Samsung phones, and Surface tablets, catering to a diverse range of users.

【BLUETOOTH CONNECTIVITY】The bluetooth keyboard and mouse combo utilize stable Bluetooth technology, offering a working range of up to 10 meters. The ipad keyboard features an American QWERTY layout, making it easy to pair and use. It includes hotkeys for volume control, play/pause, previous, and next. The back is crafted with an ultra-thin, smooth aluminum alloy design, allowing it to magnetically attach to a protective case (Not Included).

【RECHARGEABLE BATTERY】The portable keyboard is equipped with a rechargeable battery, requiring only 2 hours for a full charge. Once charged, it provides continuous usage for up to 150 hours without the need to replace batteries. The silent keyboard has a standby time of 60 days. If unused for over 10 minutes, both the keyboard and mouse will automatically enter sleep mode. Simply press any key to wake them up and resume usage. The Bluetooth mouse is powered by 2 AAA batteries (Not Included).

【COMFORTABLE AND QUIET】The wireless keyboard mouse combo features keys with a scissor-switch structure, delivering a comfortable and pleasant typing experience. The key design reduces noise, ensuring a quiet working environment. The wireless mouse comes with adjustable DPI settings (800-1000-1200) for quick and precise operations. Additionally, the mouse operates quietly, eliminating any annoying clicking sounds.
